title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via APIs 3: Using Simulators Instead of Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2502.05505v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Differentially private (DP) synthetic data enables the use of sensitive datasets while providing strong privacy guarantees. Recently, Private Evolution (PE) has emerged as a promising framework for generating DP synthetic data using only inference APIs of foundation models. However, suitable foundation models are not always available for every private data domain. In this paper, we show that PE is more general than previously understood and can incorporate APIs beyond foundation models. In particular, we show that state-of-the-art non-neural-network data synthesizers, including computer graphics-based image generators and physics simulation tools (which we refer to as simulators), integrate naturally into PE. We call the resulting method Sim-PE. Sim-PE broadens the applicability of PE while improving performance. translated_title: 通过API生成差分隐私合成数据 3：使用模拟器代替基础模型
translated_abstract: 差分隐私（DP）合成数据能够在提供强有力隐私保证的同时使用敏感数据集。近来，私有演化（PE）框架成为一种很有前景的方法，它仅利用基础模型的推理API就能生成DP合成数据。然而，对于每个私有数据领域，合适的基础模型并不总是可得。在本文中，我们证明PE比之前人们理解的更加通用，可以纳入基础模型之外的API。特别地，我们展示了最先进的非神经网络数据合成器，包括基于计算机图形学的图像生成器和物理仿真工具（我们将其统称为模拟器），能够自然地集成到PE中。我们将由此产生的方法称为Sim-PE。Sim-PE拓宽了PE的适用范围，同时提升了性能。在图像合成任务上，Sim-PE将下游分类准确率最高提升了3倍，将FID最高降低了80%。
tldr: Sim-PE将私有演化（PE）框架推广到可自然集成计算机图形图像生成器和物理仿真工具等非神经网络模拟器，从而在不依赖基础模型的情况下生成差分隐私合成数据，并将下游分类准确率提升最高3倍、FID降低最高80%。
en_tdlr: Sim-PE generalizes the Private Evolution (PE) framework to naturally incorporate non-neural-network simulators such as computer graphics-based image generators and physics simulation tools, enabling DP synthetic data generation without relying on foundation models while improving downstream classification accuracy by up to 3x and reducing FID by up to 80%.
